acceptance.description: Verify the exact Node path and SHA-256 `/opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/26.8.2/bin/node` / `902b6a6984d5d825829ea9064ab73b734548df37bc0683990dca31c8dc2a9253`; invoke verifier through `/usr/bin/env -i` with literal LANG, LC_ALL and NO_COLOR values only. Only after auditing the exact read-only dependency closure may the runner create a canonical restrictive temporary root and allowlisted child environment. If unaudited, stop before fixture, listener, child environment, or canary effects; report the prerequisite and all seven controls unverified, and verify no owned resources were created or require cleanup. Do not claim protections for resources never created.

Safely evaluate the recorded sandbox profile and its supported enforcement scope; record each control as verified, unavailable, failed, or unverified without implying that a failed or unavailable control is enforced. READY_FOR_REVIEW is eligible only if all required containment controls pass; otherwise the truthful decision is NO-RUN.

Require an audited exact read-only runtime dependency closure before any canary effects. If unavailable, report all seven controls unverified and NO-RUN before fixture/listener creation. If verified, safely evaluate exactly two positive and five negative SDK-free canaries (allowed immutable input read; allowed owned scratch write; denied outside-root synthetic read and write; denied loopback bind/listen and zero-payload connect to an owned listener; denied execution of the exact existing Node binary). Verify targets, record each actual outcome, and clean owned resources. An exit-0 NO-RUN means the preflight decision and cleanup were safely completed, not that containment succeeded.
Cleanup and bounded redacted evidence are verified; source hashes bind the exact bytes subsequently executed or used; independent code review and required check pass.
The run recommends READY_FOR_REVIEW or NO-RUN and never executes the real OpenCode SDK host.

isolation-canaries.scope: Exact Node path and SHA-256; verifier launched via /usr/bin/env -i with literal LANG=C, LC_ALL=C, NO_COLOR=1 only, preventing inherited PATH and Node loader settings from reaching Node. SDK-free macOS sandbox positive/negative controls; hashes pin and bind exact worker/canary/profile bytes to subsequent execution/use; 45-second worker limit, 16-KiB aggregate worker output, five-second reap window; outer harness `check --timeout 60` process-group watchdog with 8-KiB per-stream capture. An unaudited exact runtime dependency closure causes truthful NO-RUN before any fixture/listener/canary effect, with all controls unverified. Broad `/System`, `/usr/lib`, and package-store subtree reads are prohibited; if the prerequisite is audited, only exact dependency paths may be allowed. If that prerequisite is audited, tests use synthetic files in an owned /private/tmp root and one supervisor-owned loopback listener with zero-payload local TCP only; no routed/external network attempt; exact-root cleanup. Exit 0 means preflight evaluated and truthful READY_FOR_REVIEW or NO-RUN emitted, not that containment passed. No OpenCode SDK import, user files/config/credentials, registry or external request.
